title: MV Help with downed companions on the overworld map

posts.author: IIMeMeMine
posts.body:
Hello, I am getting back into RPG maker and am trying to create a system for when your companions are downed in battle. I want the companion's body to be placed near the player when the battle is over so you can then revive them if you have certain items. I can achieve this with
Galv's Event Spawner
but I want a radius around the player so if multiple companions go down they aren't all overlapping one another at the player's feet. I think I can achieve this with a region id that would constantly follow the player like this.
I just don't know how to make a region follow the player and haven't been able to find anything. There might be an easier way to go about this that I haven't thought of so any help would be appreciated

What about when the battle ends, an event that moves the image you want to the same location the player is, and then moves it one block? But, each character sets off a different move to a different block. So a conditional branch that if the actor has the state of Knockout, then this event runs this. Using variables, you can get the x and y coordinates of the player, and the map ID as well and use that to transfer the event itself, then flip a switch to turn the image on.
